ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell Set-Acl On Windows Folder - PsScript
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects PowerShell scripts to set the ACL to a file in the Windows folder Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Set\\-Acl\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-AclObject\\ .*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Path\\ \\"C\\:\\\\Windows.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Path\\ \\"C\\:\\/Windows.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Path\\ \\'C\\:\\\\Windows.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Path\\ \\'C\\:\\/Windows.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Path\\ C\\:\\\\Windows.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Path\\ C\\:\\/Windows.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Path\\ \\$env\\:windir.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Path\\ \\"\\$env\\:windir.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Path\\ \\'\\$env\\:windir.*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*FullControl.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Allow.*")))
